srib, you can work around this in the short term by changing that check to "i686" while we fix this.

Thanks @ahumesky. Let me try to change it to "i686".

I am trying to understand as to what caused this to break. I would appreciate any help in trying to understand why this changed and caused 32 bit builds to break.
srib: we use auto configuration for detecting C++ toolchain now and it had a bug that did not recognize i686. Fixing it right now.

I managed to get past the first OutOfMemoryError with this change:

```
--- a/scripts/bootstrap/compile.sh
+++ b/scripts/bootstrap/compile.sh
@@ -145,7 +145,7 @@ function java_compilation() {
     cat "$paramfile" >&2
   fi

-  run "${JAVAC}" -classpath "${classpath}" -sourcepath "${sourcepath}" \
+  run "${JAVAC}" -J-Xms256m -J-Xmx512m -classpath "${classpath}" -sourcepath "${sourcepath}" \
       -d "${output}/classes" -source "$JAVA_VERSION" -target "$JAVA_VERSION" \
       -encoding UTF-8 "@${paramfile}"
```

But now it cannot build Bazel with Bazel, I saw another mention of this error so tried restricting the number of jobs with this change, but it had no effect.  Any ideas?

```
--- a/scripts/bootstrap/compile.sh
+++ b/scripts/bootstrap/compile.sh
@@ -273,7 +273,7 @@ function bootstrap_build() {
       --workspace_directory=${PWD} \
       --nodeep_execroot --nofatal_event_bus_exceptions \
       build \
-      --ignore_unsupported_sandboxing \
+      --ignore_unsupported_sandboxing --jobs=50 \
       --startup_time=329 --extract_data_time=523 \
       --rc_source=/dev/null --isatty=1 \
       --ignore_client_env \
```
